steps.code:
# Get the song library, paginating through all pages
access_token = spotify_login['access_token']
all_songs = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(f"Total songs in library: {len(all_songs)}")
print(all_songs[:3])

steps.code:
# Check release dates for all songs in the library to find one released in 2022
candidates_2022 = []
for song in all_songs:
    song_details = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song['song_id'])
    release_date = song_details.get('release_date')
    print(f"Song ID {song['song_id']}: {song['title']} - release_date: {release_date}")
    if release_date and release_date.startswith('2022'):
        candidates_2022.append(song)

print(f"\nSongs released in 2022: {len(candidates_2022)}")
for s in candidates_2022:
    print(s)
